subject: Como hit nine at Lens in a record-equalling Champions League night in their first European season
title: Como hit nine at Lens. Fabregas says calm down.

lines.vo: Como's first European season, and they scored nine away from home. Nine.
lines.footage: Lens versus Como highlights, goal sequence montage

lines.vo: They won 9-1 at Lens. No team has ever scored more away from home in Champions League history. Lens did get one. Credit where due.
lines.footage: Como celebrating on the pitch, away end shots

lines.vo: Tasos Douvikas scored a hat-trick. Nico Paz added a goal and two assists. That is three goals' worth of work for one man.
Nine goals ties Bayern's record for one Champions League match. The eight-goal margin ties Liverpool's 8-0 win over Besiktas in 2007. Two records, one night. Greedy.
lines.footage: Champions League record graphic, Como squad celebration

lines.vo: Cesc Fabregas told his players not to believe their own hype. Fourth in Serie A, though, is quite a hype.
lines.footage: Fabregas press conference clip, touchline shots
